newsitem.title: USA: McDonald's plans statement, mum on rumored changes.
newsitem.headline: McDonald's plans statement, mum on rumored changes.

text.p: Fast-food giant McDonald's Corp said Wednesday it expects to make an announcement later today, but would not comment on whether it involved expected changes in its U.S. management ranks.
"We are putting out a press release later this morning," McDonald's spokeswoman Anna Rozenich said. She declined to make further comment.

U.S. franchisees have been awaiting details on expected changes in McDonald's U.S. management. One franchise source said a video broadcast to McDonald's regional managers was set for this morning to explain the changes.

The Wall Street Journal reported Wednesday that McDonald's was expected to announce changes in its U.S. unit involving at least a dozen senior officials. The newspaper quoted people close to the company.
In May, McDonald's franchisees told Reuters that the fast-food chain was drafting a plan to pare down its U.S. management to make the company more agile.

Franchisees said at the time that McDonald's had been considering establishing a few divisions in the United States, which would operate more autonomously than its current zones. McDonald's restaurants have been organized into eight zones.
McDonald's has more than 12,000 restaurants in the United States and over 21,000 worldwide.
